setup.words: The domain is a box x from -15 D to 30 D and y from -20 D to 20 D round a circular cylinder D = 10 mm along z at the origin (cut out: the box is the fluid), 5 mm deep in z (one cell across); blockage D / 40 D = 2.5 % (STEP in mm, built with OCP: a box with the cylinder cut out); a custom fluid with nu = 0.0001 m²/s and rho = 1 kg/m³, so Re = U D / nu = 100; the four sides one Freestream of 1 m/s along +x and 0 Pa, the cylinder a no-slip wall, the front and back one Symmetry (the 2D mesh's ends, solved empty); laminar; the study's reference values speed 1 m/s, area D x depth = 5e-5 m², length D, drag +x, lift +y; a Forces monitor on the cylinder, 30 Point probes on the wake axis and one at (2 D, 0.5 D); transient (pimpleFoam), 3 s (300 D/U), 50 Result frames, the time step adjusted to Courant 1, backward in time, 2 pressure correctors and 1 non-orthogonal corrector, time averages from 1.5 s; starting flow Custom U = (1, 0.05, 0) m/s.

geometry.builder: a box x from -15 D to 30 D and y from -20 D to 20 D round a circular cylinder D = 10 mm along z at the origin (cut out: the box is the fluid), 5 mm deep in z (one cell across); blockage D / 40 D = 2.5 %

estimate.n_cells_note: an order of magnitude of the 2D mesh (one cell across), not a prediction

setup.mesh_words: Hex-dominant at fineness 6, One cell across (2D) on, custom sizes on the cylinder with Refine out to (Cylinder 0.2083 mm out to 5 mm, Near wake 0.4167 mm out to 30 mm, Wake 0.8333 mm out to 80 mm), no wall layers; 1 non-orthogonal corrector

rows.text: Averaging from 1.5 s to 3 s is about 3.3 flow-throughs; a mean usually settles within 10-20 after the start-up.

estimate.line: Δt ≈ 1.1e-4 s at Max Courant 1 (smallest cells at 1 m/s) · ~26,000 steps · ~13 minutes on 8 cores · one flow-through ≈ 0.45 s · Re ≈ 100

written.label: Non-orthogonal correction
written.value: Gauss linear limited corrected 0.5 (snGrad limited corrected 0.5)

written.label: Outer relaxation
written.value: None: with 1 outer corrector every equation is solved unrelaxed (1)

written.label: Velocity limit
written.value: 50 m/s (at least 50 m/s; 10 × 1 m/s is less)

written.label: Velocity gradient
written.value: grad(U) skew-corrected (Gauss skewCorrected linear) inside the gradient limiter; linearUpwind and the viscous terms read it

written.label: Flux interpolation
written.value: flux(HbyA) skewCorrected linear; the rest linear

written.label: Solver types
written.value: GAMG for p, smoothSolver (symGaussSeidel) for U

quantities.label: Strouhal number St = f D / U (Re 100)

uncertainty.what: its difference from the mean period's St

quantities.how: f, the peak of the lift coefficient's spectrum over the window of whole shedding periods after the transient (from the first period whose lift amplitude is within 2 % of the settled one, the last 5 periods' amplitudes agreeing within 2 %; at least 20 periods): the Forces monitor's Cl resampled evenly, a Hann window, zero padded 8 times, the peak refined by a parabola through the logarithms of its three highest bins; the mean period between the window's up-crossings as the cross-check

reference.citation: C. H. K. Williamson (1988), Phys. Fluids 31:2742-2744 (experiment, and the fit St = -3.3265/Re + 0.1816 + 1.6e-4 Re = 0.1643)
reference.conditions: periodic two-dimensional (parallel) vortex shedding behind a circular cylinder in a uniform stream at Re = U D / nu = 100; St = f D / U with f the shedding (lift) frequency; Cd = F_x / (0.5 rho U^2 D) per unit span, averaged over whole periods; CL rms the lift coefficient's root-mean-square fluctuation; L the mean recirculation length from the rear stagnation point
reference.note: Williamson's St is an experiment (and its fit); the other values are 2D computations. The validity range of Williamson's fit (about 49 to 180) is not checked. A 32 D x 16 D box (blockage 6.25 %) against 64 D x 32 D (3.1 %) moved Cd by +3.0 %, CL rms by +7.6 % and St by +2.4 % (arXiv:2303.09262 Table 1, CONFIRMED as published there).

quantities.detail: f = 16.577 Hz over 39 whole periods, t = 0.6223 to 2.975 s (235.2 D/U); the spectrum's bins 0.0531 Hz apart; the mean period 0.060317 s gives St 0.16579
